note: List prices in USD per million tokens, standard tier, global routing, for compare.py and cost_model.py. Only prices read from the provider's own page are listed; a model missing here is costed as unknown. input = uncached input, cached_input = a cache hit, cache_write = a cache write at the default lifetime, output = output tokens, reasoning included (every provider here bills reasoning as output). cache: how a prompt is cached (explicit = only where the request puts a breakpoint; implicit-latest = the provider also writes through the latest message on its own; implicit = repeated prefixes are read with no write charge; none). tiers: the whole request's prices once the prompt passes `above` tokens. changes: prices from a date the provider has announced.

sources.anthropic: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and /docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, read 2026-11-02 (Phase 13 research); the same figures as the 2026-10-30 cost audit and app/ai_store.py PRICES. Cache writes at the 5-minute lifetime (1.25x input).
sources.openai: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/{gpt-6-astra,gpt-6.1-sol,gpt-6.1-terra,gpt-6-luna} and /api/docs/guides/prompt-caching, read 2026-11-02. Cache writes at the default 30-minute lifetime (1.25x input); prompts over 272K input tokens pay 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the whole request.
sources.google: aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing and /docs/caching, read 2026-11-02 (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs now redirects there). Implicit caching, minimum 4,096 tokens on Argon and 3.8 Flash; no write charge is listed for implicit caching.
sources.together: together.ai/pricing and docs.together.ai/docs/serverless/models, read 2026-11-02 (input / cached input / output).
sources.fireworks: docs.fireworks.ai/serverless/pricing, read 2026-11-02 (Standard tier: input / cached input / output).
